company.zh: 东莞魔鬼鱼科技有限公司

role.zh: 服务端 / 推理引擎开发实习生

zh: 独立设计并手写 C++17 语音合成推理引擎（不依赖 LibTorch / ONNX Runtime）：自研算子库 SLib + SpeechTokenizer 前端，51 文件 / ~5,554 行 / 134 commits。
手写 AVX2 / FMA 内核（微内核 SGEMM、im2col 卷积、因果卷积滚动 cache、对齐内存池 BufferPool），设计二进制权重格式与 mmap 零拷贝加载，并以 PyTorch / ONNX 金标逐算子验证。
主导设计两级代理 IP 池系统（~1.5 万行）：三服务 + 公共库分层、统一响应契约与增量同步水位线协议、注册表 + 策略扩展点。
设计高并发与高可用：有界队列 + 固定 worker、连接池串行 + keep-alive、单写者模型、checkpoint 断点续传与自动 failover。
en: Independently designed and hand-wrote a C++17 TTS inference engine with no LibTorch / ONNX Runtime dependency: self-built operator library SLib plus a SpeechTokenizer frontend — 51 files / ~5,554 lines / 134 commits.

Hand-wrote AVX2 / FMA kernels (a micro-kernel SGEMM, im2col convolution, causal convolution with a rolling cache, an aligned memory pool BufferPool), designed a custom binary weight format with mmap zero-copy loading, and validated it operator-by-operator against PyTorch / ONNX golden references.

Led the design of a two-tier proxy IP pool system (~15k lines): three services plus a shared library, unified response contract, incremental-sync watermark protocol, and registry + strategy extension points.

Designed concurrency and high availability: bounded queues + fixed workers, a serial connection pool with keep-alive, a single-writer model, checkpoint-based resumable execution and automatic failover.

role.zh: 软件工程 · 本科（2027 届）

主动组织学习小组、乐于分享，多次帮助同学解决技术难题，锻炼了沟通与团队协作能力。
en: Coursework: data structures & algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, database systems, C++ programming and more.
Proactively organized study groups and shared knowledge, repeatedly helping classmates solve technical problems — strengthening communication and teamwork.
